After crossing the USA–Canada border and spending nearly two hours at Canadian immigration, we finally made it into Canada!
Welcome to my first full day exploring Canada as part of our epic 6,000 KM road trip across North America in a Mercedes campervan!
In this episode, we continue our journey through Canada, experiencing the roads, landscapes, cities, and everyday life in a new country. From the open highways to discovering what makes Canada different from the United States, this is another exciting chapter of our adventure.
